name: Simple SSM: Simplified State Space Attention Block.
description: Simple SSM: Simplified State Space Attention Block.  Production-hardened across DistilBERT, RoBERTa, GPT-2, and Qwen architectures. Supports: - Multi-architecture weight copy (GPT-2, RoBERTa/BERT nested, DistilBERT, Qwen/LLaMA) - Trainable LoRA adapters with frozen base weights - GQA repeating with repeat_kv - Rotary position embeddings (RoPE) - Forward / bidirectional state-space scan - Complete

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
